body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: It also resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
After that Damage resolves, the target may move 1 unit.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Sprite
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 1 Mana to enter Sprite Full Manifestation (FM-0S). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
